name: Gutter
summary: Channels rainwater off the roof and away from the foundation.
education: Gutters keep roof runoff from soaking into the foundation and basement walls. When they clog or sag, water spills over the edge or sits stagnant, leading to wood rot at the fascia, ice dams in winter, and foundation cracks over time.

suggested_photos.prompt: Where the downspout meets the gutter

maintenance.cadence_text: Twice a year, spring and fall
maintenance.why: Clogged gutters overflow against the house and lead to foundation water damage.

maintenance.action: Inspect for sag, rust, or separation
maintenance.why: Catches loose hangers and pulled-away sections before a heavy rain reveals them.
